title: 美联储监察报告：总部翻新未发现违规，市场聚焦通胀数据
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Live from Washington, D.C., this is Balance of Power with Joe Matthew and Kaley Lines.
segments.zh: 华盛顿特区现场直播，这里是《权力平衡》，我是乔·马修和凯莉·莱恩斯。

segments.en: Wednesday edition, thanks for joining us on this last day of the month and the quarter with the market waiting for the next cue here.
segments.zh: 周三版，感谢收看本月的最后一天和本季度的最后一天，市场正在等待下一个信号。

segments.en: In this case, from Micron Technologies with earnings after the bell and of course the Treasury market driving decisions on Wall Street every day here.
segments.zh: 这次是美光科技盘后发布财报，当然，国债市场每天都在推动华尔街的决策。

segments.en: I'm Joe Matthew alongside Kaley Lines in Washington. Thanks for being with us on Bloomberg TV and Radio Kaley Treasury yields actually pushing a little bit higher from the recent highs that we've been seeing here with inflation
segments.zh: 我是乔·马修，和凯莉·莱恩斯在华盛顿。感谢收看彭博电视和广播。凯莉，国债收益率实际上从近期高点有所上升，我们一直在关注通胀

segments.en: data on the radar this morning. Yeah, cooler than expected core PCE, which may take some pressure off the notion that the Fed is going to hike in September.
segments.zh: 数据今早备受关注。是的，核心PCE低于预期，这可能减轻了美联储9月加息的压力。

segments.en: I think the market right now is only pricing or October, rather, about 40% odds of that happening.
segments.zh: 我认为市场目前只定价了10月，大约40%的可能性。

segments.en: But you also had strong consumption and spending data coming out as well, which suggests that it could be an economy that is a bit more willing to tolerate higher rates and
segments.zh: 但你也看到了强劲的消费和支出数据，这表明经济可能更愿意容忍更高的利率，

segments.en: could still mean inflationary pressures exist, which is why yields are moving higher today.
segments.zh: 这可能仍然意味着通胀压力存在，这就是今天收益率走高的原因。

segments.en: There's also a red headline crossing the Bloomberg terminal right now, the IG report into the Fed building renovation here in Washington is out in the Fed watchdog finding
segments.zh: 彭博终端上还有一条红色头条，关于美联储大楼翻修的IG报告已经发布，美联储监察机构发现

segments.en: no criminal violations in that renovation process.
segments.zh: 翻修过程中没有刑事违规行为。

segments.en: Red headline on the terminal, this is a big deal.
segments.zh: 终端上红色标题，这事不小。
